title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.08432v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. We thus propose Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support. By correcting problematic prefixes before distillation, TRD mitigates prefix failure at its source. Moreover, TRD improves exploration by exposing the student to alternative valid derivations under teacher guidance, even when the original rollouts are already correct. TRD can also be applied to on-policy

translated_abstract: 同策略蒸馏已成为大语言模型（LLM）后训练的核心工具，它在学生模型自身的生成序列上提供密集的逐 token 教师监督。在本工作中，我们识别出 OPD 中一个普遍的结构性成因，并将其称为“前缀失败”（prefix failure）。在前缀失败的情况下，密集的逐 token 监督会导致教师分布呈现双峰混合以及梯度碎片化，而 token 级别的损失截断或重加权方法均无法解决这些问题。因此，我们提出了轨迹精炼蒸馏（TRD），这是一种轨迹级别的修正方法，它在教师指导下、同时保持在同策略支撑范围内对学生模型的生成序列进行修订。通过在蒸馏之前修正有问题的前缀，TRD 从源头上缓解了前缀失败问题。此外，TRD 通过让学生模型在教师指导下接触其他有效的推理路径，提升了探索能力，即使原始生成序列本身已经正确。TRD 还可以应用于同策略……（摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出轨迹精炼蒸馏（TRD）方法，通过在教师指导下对学生模型的生成序列进行轨迹级修正，从源头解决同策略蒸馏中的“前缀失败”问题，并提升模型的探索能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises student rollouts under teacher guidance to mitigate prefix failure at its source in on-policy distillation while also improving exploration.
